headlines.headline: Trail Blazers Land Ja Morant in Trade With Grizzlies
headlines.detail: Portland acquired the former All-Star guard from Memphis in one of the offseason's biggest moves; Celtics also locked up Jordan Walsh on a 3-year, $15M extension.

headlines.headline: Chiefs Rout Broncos as Week 1 Ties Scoring Record
headlines.detail: Kansas City's dominant win helped Week 1 tie the Super Bowl-era record for most points scored in a single week. Bills christen their new stadium vs. Lions in Week 2.

headlines.headline: Texas Stuns No. 1 Ohio State With 20-Point Comeback
headlines.detail: The Longhorns erased a 20-point deficit behind their quarterback's clutch play, handing Ohio State its first loss of the season.

headlines.headline: St. John's Forward Donnie Freeman Out for Season With Achilles Injury
headlines.detail: Freeman ruptured his Achilles in a team workout and will miss all of 2026-27. Duke opens Andy Katz's preseason Power 44 at No. 1.
